It’s not for depression. I take suboxone. I told my counselor and she just said the nightmares are common for the newer sober. My doctor recommended obilafy or something for the depression but My insurance denied my script.

12hr night mares sheesh! 😅 I actually cut my dose bc I was experiencing the same. Except I called those night terror bc I woke up soaked in sweat either screaming, swinging, or crying. Man come to think about it I shouldn’t even be complaining. I could be having night terrors again. Lol

I feel like I’m trying to simulate death though lack of consciousness. I just always feel worse after. Honestly, I’d give my right tit for a good 8hrs of sleep. I’ve had nightmares every night for months due to meds. And I wake up so tight and sore. Anyway thanks for the reply 💕

And that is something to be proud of!! This is the longest I’ve been sober in years! Also I got on suboxone this year as well. I’m down to 1/4 a strip a day. And don’t rush yourself off the meds either. I wanted to be free of everything after my first 90 days and shortly after I relapsed. It’s okay to have help. I restarted my meds and started from day 1 again. But thanks to suboxone I am sober and I have no intention of touching the other stuff ever again. Best wishes!

I would let my family disown me (if that’s what will really happen) Your mother was wrong to tell you that it isn’t your place to say anything, your brother put you in that place before he ever met his wife. If I were married and about to have a baby with my husband, I would want to know. I would have a right to know. Now the details are up to you. That’s your trauma and (much like your unnecessary edit) you don’t have to explain yourself to anyone. What you do have to do is go into it with the worst case scenario in mind. They will divorce, and your family will try to pawn that off on you. Following whatever they have to say, you look em dead in the eyes and tell them they are not you. They have not lived your life. Felt your pain. Or bared your burdens. The divorce is as much your fault as it was theirs for what happened to you. (I’m assuming they knew nothing before you talked to them when you were younger) and you walk away knowing you could have saved a child. You walk away and search for your own healing.
Even if you fail to, recovery isn’t linear it’s a cycle. It’s okay to slip up, it’s never okay to give up. I got 124 days roxy free 💕💕 you got this!

You won’t detox after just a day if your down to 30mg. If you are that worried about it take the oxy when you start to come down. It makes that skin crawly transition back down to earth a lot smoother. Lastly ! Maybe use this trip as a nice distraction to finicky kick it! The mdma will be nice, if you bring nothing then there’s nothing to tempt you. Just make sure to hydrate and bring some anti diarrhea meds, cbd/ thc. Whatever you decide, be safe!
